description: This file contains service functions for managing document stores, including creation, retrieval, deletion, updating, and processing of document files and chunks within a larger application. It interacts with database entities, storage utilities, and external components to handle document data workflows.

methods.name: createDocumentStore
methods.description: Creates a new document store entry in the database and sends telemetry data.

methods.name: getAllDocumentStores
methods.description: Retrieves all document stores for a given workspace, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getAllDocumentFileChunksByDocumentStoreIds
methods.description: Fetches file chunks associated with specified document store IDs.

methods.name: deleteLoaderFromDocumentStore
methods.description: Removes a specific loader and its associated files and chunks from a document store.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreById
methods.description: Fetches a document store entity by its ID within a workspace.

methods.name: getUsedChatflowNames
methods.description: Retrieves chatflow names associated with a document store's 'whereUsed' field.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreFileChunks
methods.description: Retrieves file chunks for a specific loader or store, with pagination.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStore
methods.description: Deletes a document store and its associated chunks, files, and history.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Deletes a specific file chunk from a document store.

methods.name: deleteVectorStoreFromStore
methods.description: Deletes vector store data associated with a document store.

methods.name: editDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Edits the content and metadata of a specific file chunk.

methods.name: updateDocumentStore
methods.description: Merges and saves updates to a document store entity.

methods.name: _saveFileToStorage
methods.description: Saves a base64-encoded file to storage and updates usage metrics.

methods.name: _splitIntoChunks
methods.description: Splits document data into chunks using specified splitter and loader components.

methods.name: _normalizeFilePaths
methods.description: Rehydrates file paths from storage into base64 strings for preview.

methods.name: previewChunksMiddleware
methods.description: Handles previewing document chunks, optionally via queue processing.

methods.name: previewChunks
methods.description: Generates document chunks for preview, normalizing file paths and splitting data.

methods.name: saveProcessingLoader
methods.description: Saves or updates a processing loader configuration within a document store.

methods.name: processLoader
methods.description: Processes a loader for a document store, including chunk storage.
